title: explicit composition, plugin lifecycle, reverse teardown

acceptance_evidence.PLUGIN-CONFIG: passed - unknown component UNKNOWN_COMPONENT, dependency cycle PLUGIN_CYCLE, module/entry-point reference RUNTIME_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, unknown field PLUGIN_CONFIG, future schema_version UNSUPPORTED_CONFIG_VERSION; all fail before any start (TestPluginConfig)

acceptance_evidence.PLUGIN-DISPOSE: passed - failing disposer does not stop remaining reverse teardown; CleanupReport records closed names and per-component errors (test_failed_disposer_reports_and_continues, test_close_reports_all_failures)
acceptance_evidence.WP04-I01: passed - single ResolvedComposition bound to exact canonical config digest; fixed 12-component KNOWN_COMPONENTS inventory; changing components changes the digest (test_exact_config_digest, test_fixed_inventory)
acceptance_evidence.WP04-I02: passed - reverse-order teardown, partial-registration cleanup via Registry.load rollback, no import-time work (module only defines data/functions) (test_registry_unload_reverse_order)
acceptance_evidence.WP04-I03: passed - config can only name fixed components; module/entry_point/import/path/plugin_dir/auto_load keys raise RUNTIME_DISCOVERY_REQUIRED, deferring extension/hook/MCP trust to the separate runtime discovery responsibility (test_code_expression_config_rejected)
